x.around: You can get into the downtown by bike. If the heat is too harsh a cab ride fare usually is only US$8-15. Cabs are always outside all of the resorts.

hidden.d: You can take a short tour and learn some interesting facts about aloe farming, production and uses. Free tours every 15 minutes. No need to book ahead

x.intro: Oranjestad is the capital and largest city of Aruba. The city is home to some of the island's local residents and also many governmental buildings. Along the main "drag" (Sasakiweg street) you will find mostly tourist walking around and shopping and can also see the cruise ships that bring more and more external tourism into the island everyday.

must.d: The Historical Museum of Aruba is housed inside the oldest building on the island, the Fort Zoutman, which was built in 1798. Here, you will find information about Aruba during the Spanish and Dutch period.

x.safe: Most likely the only crime one may come across is that from other tourists. In Oranjestad the locals do not bother or even pressure tourist into their stores or to buy their products. Also as many people experience in destinations such as Jamaica, Mexico Dominican Republic. Panhandlers are not an issue at all and it is very seldom to be approached by children or homeless people for money.

hidden.d: Over 80 species of migratory birds reside in the sanctuary. Get the best view of the birds, by using the observation tower.

x.intro: Noord is in the northern part of the Caribbean island of Aruba.

Palm Beach (Aruba) is a beach resort on the island of Aruba, part of the Netherlands Antilles. Palm Beach is renowned for its two-mile long strip of beach on the Northwest end of Aruba, and is home to many water sports, piers, beach bars, restaurants, shops, and hotels. The white beaches and calm water makes the beach and region ideal for swimmers and vacationers.

intro: Aruba is a desert Caribbean island, a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Located off the coast of Venezuela, this flat, river-less island is renowned for its white sand beaches. Along with its neighboring Dutch islands of Bonaire and Curaçao, it forms the ABC Islands.

x.intro: Arikok National Park (Papiamento: Parke Nacional Arikok) is a national park accounting for about 20% of Aruba.

must.d: Another limestone cave, home to many bats. In a couple of places there are openings in the ceiling, making these caves fairly easy to explore without too much artificial lighting.
